content:
Mao’s text emphasizes eliminating the “rich-peasant economy” and “individual economy” in favor of cooperation so that “all the rural people will become increasingly well off together.”  
This points to collectivization — replacing private ownership of land with shared communal farming.  

Option (A) focuses on labor flow to cities, which is not the main point here.  
Option (B) discusses agricultural surpluses funding modernization, which is related but not the core idea of “socialist transformation” as described.  
Option (C) is about price reductions from efficiency gains, which is not the primary mechanism Mao outlines.  
Option (D) directly matches the idea of collectivization and shared fields instead of private property.  

Final answer: (D)
